clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, the Barleybrews and Thunderbrews compete for renown. Marleth Barleybrew sends you to the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos to replace a cask of Thunder Ale with her family's brew.

Ale stirs fierce pride in Khaz Modan. The Barleybrews have long resented the fame of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Marleth Barleybrew admits that Thunderbrew makes a respectable ale, but she cannot accept that it alone is renowned in Dun Morogh. She plans to shake up the local palate by replacing a cask of Thunder Ale with her own fiery Barleybrew Scalder.

The plan takes you into the distillery cellar, beneath the kitchen in Kharanos. Aging casks wait in the basement storeroom, and a guard watches near the Thunderbrews' most prized reserve. You need to draw him away before secretly switching the barrels.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson...

Here, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs!
And if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard...

clips.title: Progress
paras: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You quickly place Marleth's barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrew barrels.
